vya_text: dI0 - prasthamatra sArdhatrayodaSapalAni | tathAcoktaM ‘vamane ca vireke ca tathA SoNitamokShaNe | sArdhatrayodaSapalaM prasthamAhurmanIShiNa’ iti | nanu tantrAntare prasthaM prasthadvayaM ca krameNa raktasrAvaM kathitaM tathAhi - ‘jaGanyamadhyaprabaleShu vegAScatvAra iShTA vamane ShaDaShTau | daSaiva te dvitriguNA vireke prasthastathA SoNitamokShaNe ca’ iti | tatkkAthamatra prasthaM prasthArdhaM ca kathitaM, katham ? ucyate | tantrAntare yadidaM tadbahudoShasyAvajinaH puruShasya paraM pramANamAmananti | atra tu saSeShadoSharaktaM rakShaNIyamityAlocyAcAryeNa prasthAdisaMgrahaH kRuta ityadoShaH | tathAhi ‘raktaM svaBAvAdRutuvihitatvAdanAturasyApi raktasrutiH praSastA’ iti | yataH pittaM Saradi kupyatIti vacanAdraktasyApi kopo BavatIti niyamaH | tathAca pittaprakopeNaiva SoNitaM ca prakupyatIti| tasmAcCaradi SoNitavisrAvaNaM vihitam | tatsrAvaNAt tvagdoShAdayo~api na syu: | tvagdoShA aShTAdaSa kuShThAni nyacCanIlikAdayaSca | granthayo vAtAdimilitvA SirAgranthiSca | SothA doShaduShTiBavA vraNaSothAdayaH | AdigrahaNAt anye~api SoNitajA rogA raktagulmavidradhivisarpAdayaH || 1 || 2 ||

pada:
dvAdaSo~adhyAyaH |
atha SoNitavisrAvavidhiradhunA vidhIyate
atha SoNitasrAvavidhiH |
sambandhaScAyaM yathA lepAdayo dehakAntikarAstadvacCoNitavisrAvaNamapi |
ataH SoNitasrAvaNamAha -
SoNitaM srAvayejjantorAmayaM prasamIkShya ca | 
prasthaM prasthArdhakaM vApi prasyArdhArdhamathApi vA || 1 || 
SaratkAle svaBAvena kuryAdraktasrutiM naraH | 
tvagdoShagranthiSothAdyA na syU raktasruteryataH || 2 ||

vya_text: gU0 - atha SoNitasrAvavidhiM vyAKyAsyAma: | AmayaM raktajanyaM kuShTAdyaM rogaM prasamIkShya dRuShTvA janto: prANinaH SoNitaM srAvayet | kiyatparimitaM srAvayedityAha - prasthaM muKyaM prasthArdhaM madhyaM prasthArdhArdhaM nyUnaM vA kadA raktaM srAvayet svaBAvena raktasrAvasvaBAvena SaratkAle raktasrutiM srAvaM kuryAt, kutaH ? tvagdoShA granthiSothAdyA raktasruteryato na syuH kuShThavAtaraktAdayaH | granthirvraNAdigranthiH || 1 || 2 ||

dI0 - atha SoNitasya prakRutiM vaktumAha | madhuraM varNata iti | makShikApipIlikAdInAM prAcuryamupasarpaNAnmAdhuryamasya pratItam | varNato raktamiti | raktamAraktam indragopaprakASamityeke, tadevapadmAlaktagu~jjAPalavarNamapyuktam | athavA vastrAdilagnaM satprakShAlyamAnamapi na vivarNatAM yAtItyapare | aSItoShNamiti | na caikAntataH SItaM nAtyuShNamiti | yato~agnIShomIyAdraktasya tattulyaguNayoramlaSItayoraBilASho raktakShaye BavatIti darSanAt | athavA prakopo~asya doShaireva tanmUlatvadoShAnurUpamanuShNaSItam | tathAhi - ‘yasmAdraktaM vinA doShairna kdAcitprakupyati | tasmAttasya yathAdoShaM kAlaM vidyAtprakopanam’ iti | snigdhavisraM syAditi | snigdhaM vikShuNNaM visramAmagandhi vidAhaScAsya pittavaditi pittasya yena vastunA yathA vidAhastena vastunA tathA vidAhaH SoNitasyApItyarthaH | atha SoNite pA~jcaBautikatvaM pratipAdayannAha - yasmAdeti visrAdaya: pRuthivyAdInAM guNAH SoNite dRuSyante tasmAdraktaM pA~jcamautikamiti | tatra visratA vigandho BUmiguNaH dravatA dravaBAgo~ayamambuguNaH | rAgo raktatA tejoguNaH | calanaM naikatra sthitiSIlatvamayaM vAtaguNaH sAdanamityapare | vilaya iti vilayanopyAkASaguNaH | eke vilayasthAne laGuteti paThanti vyAKyAnayanti ca | BUmyAdipa~jcaBUtAnAmiti | AdiSabdena aptejovAyvAkASAni gRuhyante ||3 || 4 ||

pada:
Adau raktasya rasavarNaguNAdInAha -
madhuraM varNato raktamaSItoShNaM tathA guru | 
SoNitaM snigdhavisraM syAdvidAhaScAsya pittavat ||3|| 
visratA dravatA rAgaScalanaM vilayastathA | 
BUmyAdipa~jcaBUtAnAmete raktaguNAH smRutAH || 4 ||

vya_text: gU0 - raktam Adau rasato madhuraM, varNato raktaM, guNata aSItoShNaM, tathA gurumAtrayA guru, tathA snigdhaM, sacikkaNaM, visram Amagandhi, vidAho dAhakartRutvaM ca asyApi tadeva | rakte BUmyAdInAM BUtAnAM guNASca santi tAnAha - visratA AmagandhitA BUmiguNaH sacCidratA vA | ete guNAH BUmyAdipa~jcaBUtAnAM kramAtsmRutA: ||3||4||

gU0 - idAnIM duShTaraktasyA~api lakShaNamAha - rakte duShTe iti | vAtAdidoShadUShite vedanA pIDA pAko dAhaSca vraNeShveva prAcuryamasyABihitam | raktamaNDalateti raktavarNamaNDalotpattiH | kaNDUH pAmAviSeShaH, Sotho vraNaSothaH, piDakA granthAdayaH | atha raktAtivRuddhau satyAM kiM lakShaNaM tadAha -raktA~gganetratvamiti | tena raktA~gganetratA ca Bavati, sirANAM pUrNatA tatheti | sirAScAtra raktavahA j~jeyAH, tAsAM pUrNatA raktatetyarthaH | medo medovRuddhiH prAyeNAtrAsthigatamedovRuddhiH syAdityatra viShayaH yataH ‘sthUlAsthiShu viSeSheNa majjA tvaByantarASritA | athetareShu sarveShu satataM meda ucyata’ iti | kShINe~amlamadhurAkA~gkSheti | SoNitakShaye sati vAtavRuddhau satyAM tatpratIkArArthatvAdamlarasecCA | tathA raktasya dravatvAttatkShaye sati tejovRuddhau satyAM madhuraprArthanA | eke kShINe~amlaSItalAkA~gkSheti paThanti | tatrApi sa evArthaH | tvagvirUkShateti vAtavRuddhitaH sirANAM raktavahAnAM ca SaithilyaM Bavati | atiraktatvAt | GAtAtprahArAt unmArgagamitA raktasyetyarthaH | idAnIM duShTaraktasya vAtAdInAM pratyekalakShaNAnyAha | aruNAdyuktalakShaNai: kRutvA vAtadUShitaM raktaM jAnIyAt | tatrAruNamIShadraktaM kRuShNABAvaM vyAKyAnayanti | PenilaM PenayuktaM paruShamapicCilaM, tanu acCaM, SIGragamASupravRutti ata evAvaskandAdIni | askandi styAnarahitam | sUcIBiriva nistodanaM gAtreShu pittena yadA duShTaM raktaM syAttadA etAdRuSaM Bavati kiM tatpItamiti|| pItaM pItavarNam | tacca nirAmAvasthAyAM Bavati | haritaM SyAmavatpratiBAsam | nIlaM haritaSyAvam | tacca sAmAvasthAyAM Bavati | SyAvaM haritakRuShNam | visrakamAmagandhikam | askandi ceti styAnarahitam | BakShikApipIlikAnAniShTamiti | aniShTamapriyam | yataH tAsAM mate~anusaraNAdaniShTatvamavagantavyaM kaPadUShitaM raktamIdRuSaM Bavati SItalaM sparSAdvIryAt bahalaM dhanaM gairikodakasanniBamiti pANDulohitaM kathitam | mAMsapeSIpraBamitistyAnatvAt | pANDulohitamiti BAvaH | ata eva skandi kathitam | skanditvAdevamavargatvamasyoktam | atha saMsargasannipAtAnvitaraktavikRuterlakShaNAnyAha - dvidoShaduShTaM SoNitamiti SeShaH, yato dvAByAM doShAByAM dUShitaM tatsaMsRuShTamiti kathitam | etena dvAByAM lakShaNAByAM militaM BavatIti BAvaH | triduShTaM raktaM sannipAtadUShitaM kathitaM triBirdoShairdUShitaM triduShTam | tacca pUtigandhikaM Bavati | sarvalakShaNasaMyuktamiti | sarveShAM vAtapittakaPAnAM lakShaNairyuktamiti | tadeva kA~jjikABaM ca BavatIti | idAnIM viShaduShTasya raktasyAkRutiM darSayannAha - viShaM sthAvaraja~ggamaM tena duShTaM dUShitamityarthaH | IdRuSaM kena lakShitaM tadAha - SyAvamiti | haritakRuShNaM varNato Bavati | nAsikonmArgagaM tatheti | nAsikayA unmArgagAmi Bavati | tena nAdhaH pravartate iti tAtparyArthaH | viShapraBAvAt nAsikopalakShitatvAttena muKunetrakarNairapi pravartata iti BAvaH | visramityAmagandhi | sarvakuShThakaramiti viShapraBAvAt | tathAhi ‘viSheNa dUShitaM raktaM sarvakuShThakaraM matam’ iti || 5-12 ||

pada:
duShTaraktalakShaNe kiM BavatItyAha -
rakte duShTe vedanA syAtpAko dAhaSca jAyate |
raktamaNDalatA kaNDUH SothaSca piTikodgamaH || 5 || 
vRuddhe raktA~gganetratvaM sirANAM pUraNaM tathA |
gAtrANAM gauravaM nidrA mado dAhaSca jAyate || 6 || 
kShINe~amlamadhurAkA~gkSha mUrcCA ca tvaci rUkShatA | 
SaithilyaM ca sirANAM syAdvAtAdunmArgagAmitA ||7|| 
aruNaM PenilaM rUkShaM paruShaM tanu SIGragam |
askandi sUcinistodi raktaM syAdvAtadUShitam ||8|| 
pittena pItaM haritaM nIlaM SyAvaM ca visrakam |
askandyuShNaM makShikANAM pipIlAnAmaniShTakam ||9|| 
SItalaM bahalaM snigdhaM gairikodakasaMniBam |
mAMsapeSIpraBaM skandi mandagaM kaPadUShitam || 10 || 
dvidoShaduShTaM saMsRuShTaM triduShTaM pUtigandhakam |
sarvalakShaNasaMyuktaM kA~jjikABaM ca jAyate || 11 || 
viShaduShTaM BavecCyAvaM nAsikonmArgagaM tathA |
visnaM kA~jjikasaMkASaM sarvakuShThakaraM bahu || 12 ||

vya_text: gU0 - duShTe kupite rakte vedanA pIDA syAtpAkAdayaSca jAyante | raktavRuddhilakShaNamAha - vRuddhe rakte raktA~ggAdilakShaNaM Bavati raktA~ggatvaM raktanetratvaM sirANAM dhamanyAdInAM pUraNaM raktenaiva, gAtrANAM gauravaM gurutA, madaH pUgaBakShaNavat, dAha uShNatvam | kShINe rakte kiM lakShaNaM BavatItyAha -kShINe idaM Bavati - amlamadhurAkA~gkShA spRuhA, mUrcCA mUrcCitaM kShINe tvaci rUkShatA SaithilyaM vAtasyaiva unmArgagAmitA ca | vAtaduShTaraktalakShaNamAha - vAtadUShitaM raktam evaMvidhaM syAt | kiMBUtaM tadAha - aruNaraktaM PenilaM Penavat, rUkShaM sneharahitaM, tanu adhanaM, paruShaM karkaSaM, SIGragamanaM SIlaM askandi, GanatvarahitaM, visrAvaviSeShaH srAvayuktaM, pittadUShitaraktamAha - pittena dUShitaM pItaharitAdivarNaM raktaM Bavati tadAha - visrakaM srAvagandhi askandi cA~jcalyarahitaM makShikAdInAM aniShTakaM BakShaNe hitaM na | kaPadUShitaraktamAha - kaPadUShitaM SItalAdilakShaNaM BavatItyAha - SItalaM SItaguNaM sparSena vA SItalaM, bahulaM bahutaraM, snigdhaM sacikkaNaM, gairikodakasanniBaM gairikajalasadRuSaM, punaH mAMsapeSIpraBaM granthirUpaM, skandi GanatvasadRuSaM, mandagaM mandagamanaM, dvidoShatridoShaduShTalakShaNamAha – dvidoShaduShTasaMsRuShTadvidoShalakShaNamAha - dvidoShaduShTasaMsRuShTaM dvidoShalakShaNayuktaM Bavati triduShTaM tridoShaduShTaM pUtigandhaM durgandhaM tathA kA~jjikABaM ca jAyate | viShaduShTamAha - viShaduShTaM viShayuktaM SyAmavarNaM Bavet nAsikAgandhaM tathA unmArgagam | visram Amagandhi, kA~jjikasaMkASaM kA~jjikatulyaM tathA sarvakuShThakaraM, tathA bahu adhikam || 5-12 ||

dI0 - atha vikRutaraktamaBidhAya prakRutisthaM darSayannAha - yaH prAvRuTkAlajo jantuviSeShaH indravadhUriti loke | sa cAnekaprakAravarNaH, atra tu rakta eva gRuhyate | asaMhatamiti nAtyacCaM nAtiGanaM na styAyatItyanye ||
gU0 - indragopo vIravadhUTI tadvat raktaM tathA asaMhatam astyAnam evaMBUtaM prakRutisthaM raktaM j~jeyam ||

dI0 - atha raktasrAvo yeShAM vihitastAnAha - Sothe vraNaSothe ekA~ggaje~api srAvyaH | yataH sarvA~ggaSotho niShiddhaSca sa vAmlaBojananimittaH | pANDurogyarSasodariSoShigarBiNInAM ca Svayathau, a~ggadAhe a~ggapAke ca | raktavarNe~asRujaH srutAviti kevalaraktapitte | sapIDe durjaye~anile iti | tathAhi - ‘uShNAmlalavaNAdervAtaharasyopayogAtkupitena SoNitenAvRuto vAto yadA vedanAkArI tadA sirAvyadha iti | pANiroge dAhAdau tena bAhurogo~api gRuhyate | yaduktaM -SoNitAvRutavAtajanitayorbAhuSoShApabAhukayorapyaMSayorantare sirAvyadhaH | apacyAmiti | utpannamAtrAyAmityarthaH | na tu rUDhAyAM tasyAm | kShudrarogeShu arUMShikAdiShu | vidradhAviti ShaDvidhavidradhiShu madhye pacca visrAvyAH taduktaM - ‘srAvyA vidradhayaH pa~jca BaveyuH sarvapAdata’ iti | upadaMSe iti | upadaMSagrahaNAt parivartikaSUkadoShaSukavyApatsu ca meDhramadhye sirAvyadhaH | raktapittamiti | romakUpodgatamityeke | SeShaM subodham | atha SoNitavisrAvaM yairvastuBiH kuryAttAni darSayannAha - eShu pUrvokteShu SothapraBRutiShu rogeShu SRu~ggAdicatuHprakArA yathAyogyAnurUpato yojyA | SRu~ggaM tu goSRu~ggaM tacca saptA~ggulavistIrNaM Bavati | tathAca ‘srAve tu SvetagoSRu~ggaM vakraM saptA~ggulAyataM | kShiptvAntaH picupeSIkaM yojyaM vAtayute~asRuji | a~gguShThamUlavanmUlaM Cidramagre~asya mudgavat | vastrapaTTAvanaddhaM ca raktamAcUShaNAddharet’ iti | jalaukAH prasiddhAH, tASca dvAdaSadhA Bavanti | tAsAM ShaT saviShA: tAvantya eva nirviShASca | vistAro~api tAsAmanyatra#foot@ - saviShalakShaNaM vAgBaTe - ‘indrAyudhavicitrordhvarAjayo romaSASca yAH| saviShA varjayettABiH kaNDUpAkajvaraBramaH’ iti | jalamokaH sthAnaM yAsAM tAH | dvividhA striyaH puruShASca | tanva~ggyo~atyantamRudavaH striyo viparItAH puruShA | striya: sukumAreShu asukumAreShu puruShA yojyAH |# j~jAtavyaH | atra granthagauravaBayAnna liKitaH | alAbukA tumbISabdavAcyA | tasyA lakShaNaM kenaciditi darSitam | tadyathA - a~gguShThA~ggulapariNAhA ca - tura~ggulA~anASasaMmitA sumuKA kRuShNamRudAliptatanuH SreShThA raktA ca sevane~alAbUH | sAntardIrGamayutA tayA ca visrAvayedraktamiti | SirAmokShairiti SirA raktavahAstAsAM mokShaH SastreNa kuryAditi | mokSho rudhirasyeti || 13-18 ||

pada:
yeShu raktasrAvo vihitastAnAha -
Sothe dAhe~a~ggapAke ca raktavarNe~asRujaH srutau || 13|| 
vAtarakte tathA kuShThe sapIDe durjaye~anile |
pANiroge SlIpade pade ca viShaduShTe ca SoNite || 14 || 
granthyarbudApacIkShudrarogaraktAdhimanthiShu |
vidArIstanarogeShu gAtrANAM sAdagaurave || 15 || 
raktABiShyandatandrAyAM pUtiGrANAsyadehake |
yakRutplIhavisarpeShu vidradhau piTikodgame ||16|| 
karNauShThaGrANavaktrANAM pAke dAhe Siroruji |

vya_text: gU0 - Sothe dAheti SothAdirogeShu nRuNAM raktasrAvaH praSasyata ityanvayaH | raktavarNe dehe asRujaH srutau sAdisrAve sapIDe pIDAsahite anile durjaye jetumaSakye gAtrasAdo gAtraSaithilyaM raktABiShyandam AraktanetraM, spaShTamanyat | eShu rogeShu kena raktaM srAvayedityAha - jalaukA nirviShA purAtanASca ‘mahyakAM vAjayavanayAjyapautanayA (?) SuBA’ iti suSrutoktatvAt alAbu tumbISirA tadvidhAnasthAnaM taddvidhA nipuNairvaidyairj~jeyam || 13-18 ||

dI0 - atha yeShAM sirAmokShaNaM na syAttAnAha - kRuSasya kShINasya puMsaH | klIbo napuMsakaH | pa~jcakarmeti | vamanavirecananiruhAnuvAsananasyAni taiH Sodhitasya puMsaH | sarvA~ggaSothayuktAnAmiti | sarvA~ggatvena vraNaSothA ekA~ggatA api gRuhyante | AGAtAtprahArAdinA srutaM raktaM yasya sirAmokSho dvividhaH pracCannaH sirAvyadhaSva | ‘na kurvIta sirAmokShaM kRutasyAtivyavAyina’ ityAdivyAKyA pUrvaM pratipAditA | adhunA~api viSeShamAha | kRuSasya garBiNInAM copakShINadhAtutvAddehaBayAt | ativyavAyino vAtaprakopaBayAnna vidhyet | klIbasya pradhAnadhAtukShaye alpasatvena ca niHsRutavinASAt | BIroSca tamobahulatvAllohitadarSanena mUrcCABayAnna vidhyet | sUtikAyA garBiNIvat | pa~jcakarmaviSuddhasyetyAdi | vAntaviriktayoraktasarjanayorapItasnehayorvamanavirecanAnantarameva vAtaprakopaBayAcCirAM na vidhyet | AsthApitajAgaritayormarutprakopaBayAnna vidhyet | anuvAsitasya mande~agnau BUyo~agnimAndyaBayAt | anye vyadhA anumAnato nirUpaNIyAH | sirAmokSho na Sasyata iti dvirukte sati viSeSheNa sirAniShedhaparatvAt vAcyaH, Atyayike tu SRu~ggAlAbujalaukApraBRutiparatvAccAvekShya | athAtyayike kRuSAdInAmapi SoNitavisrAvaviShayaM vaktumAha - eShAmiti| pUrvoktAnAM kRuSAdInAmapi yadi AthAtyayike roge sati tadA jalaukABirnirharet | paramasukumArayogatvAnnirharedvisrAvayecCoNitamiti SeShaH | atyayo~avinASo BavatyasmAdityAtyayiko vidradhyAdirananyasAdhyaH | tathA viShajuShTAnAM puruShANAmapi jalaukABistu nirharaNaM kartavyam | na kevalaM jalaukABiH sirAmokSheNApi viShapraBAveNa sakalaSarIradUShitatvAt sarvaM raktaM dUShitameva | ata eva sirAmokShaH | yataH ‘sirAsarvA~ggaSodhinI’ iti vacanAt || 19-22 ||

pada:
yeShu sirAmokSho niShiddhaH tAnAha -
na kurvIta sirAmokShaM kRuSasyAtivyavAyina:| 
klIbasya BIrorgarBiNyAH sUtikApANDurogiNAm ||19|| 
pa~jcakarmaviSuddhasya pItasnehasya cArSasAm | 
sarvA~ggaSothayuktAnAmudaraSvAsakAsinAm ||20|| 
CardyatIsAraduShTAnAmatisvinnatanorapi | 
UnaShoDaSavarShasya gatasaptatikasya ca || 21 ||
AGAtasrutaraktasya sirAmokSho na Sasyate | 
eShAM cAtyayike roge jalaukABistu nirharet ||22||

vya_text: gU0 - kRuSasya durbalasya ativyavAyinaH atistrIsaktasya pa~jcakarmANi vamanadIni tacCuddhasya atisvinnatanoH atisveditasya UnaShoDaSavarShasya bAlasya gatasaptatikasya ata UrdhvaM vRuddhasyetyarthaH | AGrANena nAsikayA raktaM srutasya eShAM ca Atyayike na kAryaM jalaukAmI raktaM na haret || 19-22 ||

dI0 - atha doShaviSeSheNa SRu~ggAdiviShayaM viBajannAha - BiShagiti grahaNAddRuShTakramo j~jeyaH | tena vAtaduShTaM SRu~ggeNa, yataH ‘uShNaM samadhuraM SRu~ggaM gavyaM snigdhaM prakIrtitam | tasmAdvAtopasRuShTeShu hitaM tadavasecane’ iti | pittaduShTaM tu rudhiraM jalaukABirnirharet | tathAhi ‘SItAdhivAsA madhurA jalaukA vArisaMBavA | tasmAtpittopasRuShTe tu hitA sA tvavasecane’ iti | kaPaduShTaM tu - alAbuBiriti | athAtivyastamaBidhAya pittadoShaduShTasya raktasyAvasecanopAyamAha - dvidoShAByAmityAdipadaiH krUrapradhAnaiH yuktetyanena yathAyogyAnurUpaM yojyam | tena padopalakShitatvAcCRu~ggAlAbupracAro~avagantavyaH | yaduktaM ‘sarvANi vAtapittakaPaduShTAni SoNitAni’ | sarvairiti SRu~ggAdiBiryathAyogyamityaBiprAyaH | atha SRu~ggAdInAM kiyaddUre pracArastaM darSayannAha - daSA~ggulamityuBayataH | tena caturdikShu daSA~ggulamiti BAvaH | evaM sarvatra viShayapadaM pracCannam | ata evAha kaScit - ‘avagADhe jalaukA syAtpracCannaM piNDite hitam | sirA ca vyApake rakte SRu~ggAlAbu tvaci sthite’ iti | atha SoNitaM na srAvayettAnAha - SIte iti | SIte SItArdite deSe puruShe ca niranne iti la~gGite | atitandrA nidrAnASaH | yaduktaM ‘madamUrcCASramArtAnAM vAtaviNmUtrasa~gginAm | nidrA~aBiBUtaBItAnAM nRuNAM nA~asRuk pravartate’ iti | viNmUtrasaMginAmiti | viNmUtrAdInAM saMgo pravRuttistadyuktAnAmityarthaH | viNmUtragrahaNenaiva vAtasaMgasyApyavarodhaH || 23-27 ||

padama~ggulamAtrasya sirA sarvA~ggaSodhinI || 26 || 
SIte niranne mUrcCAyAM tandrABItimadaSramaiH |
yutAnAM na sravedraktaM tathA viNmUtrasa~gginAm ||27||

vya_text: gU0 - SRu~ggAdInAM SoNitagrahaNe pramANamAha - sugamam | yeShAM raktaM na srAvayet tAnAha - SIte SItakAle viNmUtrasaMginAM apravartinAm || 23-27 ||

dI0 - idAnImapravartitasya SoNitasya cikitsAyogaM vaktumAha - yadA SItAdihetuBirna sravettadA trikaTukAdicUrNaM kRutvA vraNaM GarShayet | trikaTukaM SuNThImaricapippalIsaMj~jaM, kuShThaM prasiddhaM, saindhavaM ca, SeShaM sugamam || 28 ||

pada:
rakte vidhAnamAha -
apravartitarakte ca kuShThatrikaTusaindhavaiH | 
mardayedvraNavaktraM ca tena samyakpravartate || 28 ||

vya_text: gU0 - vraNavaktraM vraNamuKaM, SoNitasamayavidhAnaM cAha, sugamam || 28 ||

dI0 - tasmAditi pUrvoktApravartitaraktaviShayadarSanAt | na SIte nAtyuShNeti sAdhAraNakAle | ata evoktaM suSrute - ‘vyaBre varShAsu vidhyeta grIShmakAle tu SItale | hemantakAle madhyAhne SastrakAlAstrayo matA’ iti | na svinne iti svedite | nAtitApite iti SramAdiBiH saMtapte | sUryatApAdityanye | pItvA yavAgUM tRuptasyeti | yavAgUratra tilayavAgU: tasyAH sadyaH snehanIyatvAt | raktotkleSakAritvAcca | anye tu yavAgUrviraladraveti bahusRutAm | tRuptasyeti kathanAt || 29 ||

pada:
idAnIM suKavisrAvaNArthaM hitopadeSamAha -
tasmAnna SIte nAtyuShNe na svinne nAtitApite | 
pItvA yavAgUM tRuptasya srAvayecCoNitaM budhaH ||29||

vya_text: dI0 - atisvinnetyatyarthaM svedite puruShe deSe vA | soShNakAle grIShmartau SaradRutau vA | atisirAvyadhAditi aj~japrayuktena SastreNAvagADhavyadhanAdraktAtisrutirBavati | pUrvamuktaM tatra kuryAtpratikriyAmityataH tAM pratikriyAM darSayannAha - atra sarjaraso rAlaH| rasA~jjanaM prasiddhaM | yacca dArvIkvAthasamudBavaM rasA~jjanasaMj~jaM keciditi vyAKyAnayanti | sarjaH SAlaBedaH | rasA~jjanaM tadeva | dhavo vRukShaviSeShaH prasiddhaH | dhanvano dhAmana iti prasiddhaH | lodhrAdiBiScUrNIkRutABirvraNamuKamavacUrNyA~ggulyagreNAvapIDayediti pracAraH | sarpanirmokaH sarpaka~jculikA | kShaumavastrayorBasmeti | paTAmbaradagdhaBasma kShaumam atasIBavam | taddagdhvA BasmakAryam evaM vastrasya vastragrahaNAt kArpAsasaMBavaM BasmApi muKavraNasya | badhveti yathoktavraNabandhanadravyairgADhaM badhnIyAdityarthaH | SItaiScopacaredvraNaM SItAcCAdanaBojanAgAraiH SItaiH pradehapariShekaiSca vraNaM SastrAdijanitaM yadyupacaret | vA pakShAntaraprakAramAha - vidhyedUrdhvamityAdi | prAktanavyaktAt parasthAne tAmeva pUrvaviddhAM sirAM vidhyet | raktagaticCedanArtham kShAreNAgninA vA dahediti vastrAdipadABiprAyaH | atha lodhrAdInAM SoNitAtipravRuttau prayuktAnAM pratyekaPalamAha -kaShAyo~atra lodhrasarjarasA~jjanapraBRutikaH | sa ca vraNaGarShaNArthaM pUrvamevAtra darSitaH | anye tu harItakyAdiH pa~jcavalkalAdikaH | etena kimuktam, ayaM kaShAyaH vraNaM SastrAGAtajaM rudhiraM saMdhatte nivArayedityarthaH | vraNagrahaNena jalaukAmuKakShatajamapi grAhyam | himaM SItalam | raktamityatipravartitaM skandayedastyAnIBUtaM karotItyarthaH | kShAro~atra vihito~apAmArgAdijanitaH kShaumAdijanito vetyatra vihitaH, sa ca vraNAsyaM vraNamuKaM pAcayet | tenAtipravartitaraktaM saMsthApya samyakprarohayedityaBiprAyaH | dAho~agnikRutaH SalAkApravRuttiBiH sa ca SirAM raktavahAM saMkocayet | tenAtipravartitaM samyagavatiShThate | idAnIM raktAtisrAve upadeSaM darSayannAha | ataH srAvyaM sAvaSeShaM iti | sAvaSeShaM doSharaktaM punaH saMSamanAdiBirjayedityaBiprAyaH | yathAtiyoganiHsRutasya raktasya vyApadaM darSayannAha | AndhyamandhatAm | atrordhvajatrugatarogaM SirasyatipravRuttaM raktaM karoti | SeShaM subodham | atha raktasrAvaNe BUyoBUyotikramo na karaNIya ityAha | utpattiriti | upasthitipralayeShu SoNitameva hetuH SoNitena | etenaiva dhAryate sthApyate | SeShaM sugamam || 30-40 ||

pada:
atha kena hetunA raktAtipravRuttistaddarSayannAha -
atisvinnasyoShNakAle tathaivAtisirAvyadhAt | 
atipravartate raktaM tatra kuryAtpratikriyAm || 30|| 
atipravRutte rakte ca lodhrasarjarasA~jjanaiH | 
yavagodhUmacUrNairvA dhavadhanvanagairikaiH || 31 ||
sarpanirmokacUrNairvA BasmanA kShaumavastrayoH | 
muKaM vraNasya baddhvA ca SItaiScopacaredvraNam || 324|| 
vidhyedUrdhvaM sirAM tAM ca dahetkShAreNa vAgninA | 
vraNaM kaShAyaH saMdhatte raktaM skandayate himam ||23|| 
vraNAsyaM pAcayetkShAro dAhaH saMkocayetsirAm | 
vAmANDaSothe dakShasya karasyA~gguShThamUlajAm || 34 || 
dahetsirAM vyatyaye tu vAmA~gguShThasirAM dahet | 
sirAdAhapraBAveNa muShkaSothaH praNaSyati || 35 || 
viShUcyAM pArShNidAhena jAyate~agneH pradIpanam | 
saMkucanti yatastena rasaSleShmavahAH sirAH || 36 || 
yadA vRuddhiryakRutplIhnoH SiSoH saMjAyate~asRujaH | 
tadA tatsthAnadAhena saMkucantyasRujaH sirAH ||37|| 
rakte duShTe~avaSiShTe~api vyAdhirnaiva prakupyati | 
ataH srAvyaM sAvaSeShaM raktaM nAtikramo hitaH ||38|| 
AndhyamAkShepakaM tRuShNAM timiraM Siraso rujam | 
pakShaGAtaM SvAsakAsau hikkAM dAhaM ca pANDutAm ||39|| 
kurute~atisRutaM raktaM maraNaM vA karoti ca | 
dehasyotpattirasRujA dehastenaiva dhAryate || 40 ||
vinA tena vrajejjIvo rakShedraktamato budhaH |

vya_text: gU0 - atisvinnasyeti sugamam | atipravRutte kriyAmAha - atipravRutte rakte evaM kuryAttadAha -lodhraM, sarjo rAlaH, rajA~jjanaM dArvIkvAthodBavaM, yava kAShThadhanvanaH | sarpanirmokaM sarpakaMcukaM vastraM cIraM kShaumaM paTTavastram | SItaiH SItopacAraiH tAM SirAM bAhu UrdhvaM vidhyet | UrdhvaM tasmAt SirAbandhAt Urdhvam | tathAca vAgBaTe ‘tAmeva vA SirAM vidhyedbandhAttasmAdanantaram’ iti | kShAreNa dahet lipetkShAreNa Ta~gkaNAdinA kShAreNa vahninA vA daheddAhaM kuryAt | kaShAyaH kaShAyadravyaM rodhrAdi vraNaM saMdhatte saMnahanaM saMkurute| himaM SItalaM candanAdidravyaM raktaM skandayate SoShayati sthApayati vA, kShAraH vraNaM pAcayati, dAhaH SirAH saMkocayet dAho yathA sugamam | visUcyAmiti sugamam | duShTe rakte niHsRute kiMcidavaSiShTe~api vyAdhirna kupyati ataH sAvaSeShaM srAvyam | atikramo na hitaH | raktasya niSe:ShasrAve doShasrAvaNAttadAha - atisrutaM atiniHsRutaM raktasya jIvasya sAmye | taddehasyotpAtAdInAha - sugamam || 30-40 ||

dI0 - atha SoNitAvaSeke paScAt karma darSayannAha | SItopacArAH sekAdyAH | etena kimuktaM, anatiSItAdikaM prayatnataH upAcaraNIyamiti subodham| ata eva koShNena sarpiSheti | IShaduShNena sarpiShetyarthaH | atha raktAtikrameNa kShINasya puruShasyAnantaraM BeShajamAha - kShINasyeti | raktakShINapuruShasyetyarthaH | eNaH kRuShNamRugaH | uraBro meShaH | hariNastAmravarNo mRugaH | eShAM mAMsaiH saMsruto rasa iti| eke hariNacCAgasaMBavaH raktaH samucita iti paThanti vyAKyAnayanti ca | kShIraM vA ShaShThikA hitA iti | kShIrAdisiktamodanaM Bu~jjItetyaBiprAyaH || 41 || 42 ||

pada:
srute rakte~api doShakope pratIkAramAha - 
SItopacAraiH kupite srutaraktasya mArute || 41 || 
koShNena sarpiShA SothaM savyathaM pariShecayet |
kShINasyaiNaSaSoraBrahIraNacCAgamAMsajaH || 42 || 
rasaH samucitaH pAne kShIraM vA ShaShThikA hitAH |

vya_text: gU0 - srute rakte vraNasthAne kupite dAhAditvAt SItopacAraiH upacaretsrutaraktasya mArute kupite savyathaM SothaM koShNena sarpiShA secayet | rakte kShINe kriyAmAha - kShINasya raktasrAvaNakShINasya puruShasya eNAdInAM mAMsarasaH hitaH | ShaShThikAyuktaM kShIraM vA hitam | eNo hariNaH, SaSaH, uraBro meShaH, hariNaH kRuShNavarNo mRugaH, eNo raktavarNaH CAgaH || 41 || 42 ||
dI0 - pIDASAMtirvedanAvyapagamaH | laGutvaM SarIrasyeti | etacCArIraM visrAvitali~ggam | manaHsvAsthyamiti manasaH prasAdaH | etena mAnasaM li~ggaM SeShaM sugamam ||43||

pada:
atha raktasrAvaNAt samyak SuddhilakShaNAnyAha - 
pIDASAntirlaGutvaM ca vyAdherudrekasaMkShayaH || 43 || 
manaHsvAsthyaM BaveccihnaM samyagvisrAvite~asRuji |

vya_text:
gU0 - samyak srutaraktalakShaNamAha - asRuji rakte samyakvisrAvite sati pIDASAntyAdilakShaNaM BavatIti yojanA | pIDA vyathA tacCAnti: laGutvaM dehasya vyAdheH rogasya punaH udreka AdhikyaM tasya saMkShayaH samyak nASaH manaHsvAsthyam || 43 ||
raktamokShe niShedhavargamAha -

idAnIM raktasrute: kiM tyAjyaM taddarSayannAha - atrAtiSayaM niShiddhaM na tu sakRudeva | SokaM dhanabandhunASAdijanitam | vAdamityatiBAShaNam | AbaladarSanAditi | raktasrutasya yAvadbalo na Bavati tAvadvyAyAmAdayo niShiddhA ityaBiprAyaH || 44 || 45 ||

SoNitavisrAvavidhiradhyAyaH || 12 ||

ekASanaM divAsvapnaM kShArAmlakaTuBojanam |
SokaM vAdamajIrNaM ca tyajedAbaladarSanAt || 45 || 
iti SrIdAmodarasUnunA SAr~ggadharAcAryeNa viracitaSAr~gga-
